title: Desi daru

{{Short description|Type of liquor}} {{Infobox beverage | name = Desi daru
देसी दारू | image = Desi daru (desi liqour) with Orange flavor.jpg | caption = Desi daru with Orange flavor | type = [[distilled spirit]] | abv = 28.5%–42.5% | proof = 50° | manufacturer = | distributor = | origin = [[India]] | introduced = | discontinued = | colour = White and Brown | flavour = | ingredients = | variants = | related = | website = }} '''Desi daru''' ({{langx|hi|देसी दारू}}), also known as '''country liquor''' or '''Indian-made Indian liquor''' ('''IMIL'''), is a local category of [[liquor]] produced on the [[Indian subcontinent]], as opposed to [[Indian-made foreign liquor]]. Due to cheap prices, country liquor is the most popular alcoholic beverage among the impoverished people. It is [[fermented]] and distilled from [[molasses]], a by-product of [[sugarcane]].{{cite book|author=Bhaichand Patel|title=Happy Hours: The Penguin Book of Cocktails|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=oGWQddFYuqIC&pg=PT206|date=19 October 2009|publisher=[[Penguin Books]] Limited|isbn=978-81-8475-162-8|pages=206 ff}}{{cite news |author=David Shaftel |url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/thwR3uoMpibRWW73gRKzAK/Boom-time-for-country-liquor.html |title=Boom time for country liquor |work=Livemint |date=2011-11-23 |access-date=2015-08-03}}{{cite news |author=Ratna Bhushan & Boby Kurian |url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2008-01-22/news/27733976_1_country-liquor-imfl-bis |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111114234410/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2008-01-22/news/27733976_1_country-liquor-imfl-bis |url-status=dead |archive-date=November 14, 2011 |title=Manufacturing norms for country liquor on anvil |newspaper=[[Times of India]] |date=2008-01-22 |access-date=2015-08-03}} Desi liquor is a broad term and it can include both legally and illegally made local alcohol. The term ''desi daru'' usually refers to legal alcohol while other types of country liquor ([[arrack]] and [[palm toddy]]) may be categorised as [[moonshine]] alcohol.{{cite web|url=http://www.thefreedictionary.com/Desi+daroo |title=Desi daroo - definition of Desi daroo |work=[[The Free Dictionary]] |access-date=2015-08-03}} ==Etymology== {{main|Desi}} The term ''[[desi]]'', a [[Hindustani language|Hindustani]] term derived from [[Sanskrit]] ''[[desh]]'' (country or region), which is generally an [[Exonym and endonym|endonym]] for the ''compatriot'' or ''local'' is often applied to food or drink that is considered traditional or native. ''Dārū'' ([[Hindi]] [[wiktionary:दारू|दारू]] and [[Urdu]] [[wiktionary:دارو|دارو]]) is a [[Persian language|Persian]]-derived term mostly used for any alcoholic beverage in India. ''Śarāb'' (Hindi [[wiktionary:शराब|शराब]] and Urdu [[wiktionary:شراب|شراب]]) is another [[Arabic]]-derived equivalent and is used in some areas with somewhat less frequency.{{cite book|author=Carlos E. Cortés|title=Multicultural America: A Multimedia Encyclopedia|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=VQ1zAwAAQBAJ&pg=PA1162|date=3 September 2013|publisher=SAGE Publications|isbn=978-1-4522-7626-7|pages=1162–}} ==Industry== [[File:Desi daru una.jpg|Una Brand Desi daru|150px|alt=Una Brand Desi daru|thumb]] An article in the medical journal ''[[The Lancet]]'' estimated that nearly two-thirds of the alcohol consumed in India is country liquor.{{cn|date=July 2022}} ''Globus spirits'' mentioned that India's country liquor market is about 242 million cases (over 30% of the beverage industry in India) with a growth rate of about 7% per annum.{{cite web|url=https://www.globusspirits.com/documents/Indian-Made-Indian-Liquor-market-May-14.pdf |title=Indian Made Indian Liquor (IMIL) |publisher=Globus Spirits |access-date=2015-08-03}} No data regarding [[Pakistan]] is available as drinking alcohol is officially prohibited for Muslims in Pakistan, although locally made liquor is sold on the black market.{{cite news |last=Craig |first=Tim |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/in-dry-pakistan-deaths-from-toxic-liquor-continue/2014/10/08/bf149e5c-4f1a-11e4-babe-e91da079cb8a_story.html |title=In dry Pakistan, deaths from toxic liquor continue |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]] |date=2014-10-08 |access-date=2015-08-05}}{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-24044337 |title=Pakistan battles growing alcohol addiction |publisher=[[BBC News]] |access-date=2015-08-05}} Government regulation provide for a separate licensing for production, distribution and retailing of country liquor (IMIL) as opposed to [[Indian-made foreign liquor]]. ==Social issues== {{Further| Temperance movement in India}} Country liquor, being the cheapest alcohol in India, is the mainstay alcoholic beverage for the rural population and urban poor. In rural areas, illicit country liquor has been blamed for [[domestic violence]] and poverty in the family. There have been several protests against country liquor shops/bars in villages.{{cite news |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bhubaneswar/Women-vandalize-country-liquor-shop/articleshow/47979689.cms |title=Women vandalize country liquor shop |newspaper=The Times of India |date=2015-07-08 |access-date=2015-08-03}}{{cite news |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/meerut/Women-protest-against-sale-of-illicit-liquor/articleshow/46189055.cms |title=Women protest against sale of illicit liquor |work=The Times of India |date=2015-02-10 |access-date=2015-08-03}}{{cite news |url=http://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/women-protest-against-liquor-shop/article6973029.ece |title=Women protest against liquor shop |newspaper=[[The Hindu]] |date=2015-03-09 |access-date=2015-08-03}} ===Adulteration === As country liquor is cheaper than other spirits, there have been reports of mixing country liquor with [[Scotch whisky|Scotch]]/[[English whisky]] in many bars in India to maximise the profit.{{cite news |url=http://www.mid-day.com/articles/pay-for-scotch-drink-desi-daru/98528 |title=Pay for Scotch drink Illicit Desi daru - News |work=Mid-day |access-date=2015-08-03}} ===Harmful moonshine alcohol=== When moonshine desi daru is made illegally and if the distillation process and the proper equipment is not used, harmful impurities such as [[fusel alcohol]]s, [[Lead poisoning|lead]] from plumbing solder, and [[methanol]] can be concentrated to toxic levels in the moonshine desi daru. Several deaths have been reported in India and Pakistan due to consumption of illegally-made toxic moonshine liquor.{{cite news |title = 86 Deaths Blamed on Toxic Indian Moonshine|url = http://www.cbsnews.com/news/86-deaths-blamed-on-toxic-indian-moonshine/|work=www.cbsnews.com|access-date = 2015-08-03}}{{cite web|title = 42 People In India Have Died After Drinking Toxic Alcohol| website=[[BuzzFeed]] | date=22 October 2013 |url = https://www.buzzfeed.com/tasneemnashrulla/42-people-in-india-have-died-after-drinking-toxic-alcohol#.mkPJzY7V|access-date = 2015-08-03}} ==In popular culture== There are several references of desi daru in [[Bollywood]] films, songs. *The 2012 film ''[[Cocktail (2012 film)|Cocktail]]'' has a song named ''Daru Desi'' sung by [[Benny Dayal]] and [[Shalmali Kholgade]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bollywoodlife.com/news-gossip/cocktail-song-daaru-desi/ |title=COCKTAIL song: Daru Desi - Bollywood News & Gossip, Movie Reviews, Trailers & Videos at |publisher=Bollywoodlife.com |date=2012-06-02 |access-date=2015-08-03}} *The 2011 film ''[[F.A.L.T.U]]'' has a party song named ''Char Baj Gaye (Party Abhi Baaki Hai)'' with references to desi daru.{{cite news |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/top-10-videos/Top-10-Drunken-Numbers-of-Bollywood/videols/11446608.cms |title=Top 10 Drunken Numbers of Bollywood - Top 10 - Hindi - Entertainment |work=The Times of India |date=2012-01-11 |access-date=2015-09-22}}{{cite web |url=http://www.glamsham.com/music/lyrics/faltu/char-baj-gaye/1597/3323.htm |title=Char Baj Gaye Song Lyrics of F.A.L.T.U |publisher=glamsham.com |access-date=2015-09-22 |archive-date=2018-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180907150506/http://www.glamsham.com/music/lyrics/faltu/char-baj-gaye/1597/3323.htm |url-status=dead }} *Scenes in the 2011 film ''[[Rockstar (2011 film)|Rockstar]]'' shows lead actor [[Ranbir Kapoor]] and lead actress [[Nargis Fakhri]] drinking desi daru.{{cite news |url=http://www.telegraphindia.com/1111112/jsp/entertainment/story_14740092.jsp |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111113164037/http://www.telegraphindia.com/1111112/jsp/entertainment/story_14740092.jsp |url-status=dead |archive-date=November 13, 2011 |title=Rahman and Ranbir rock it, but imtiaz disappoints |work=The Telegraph |location=Kolkata |date=2011-11-12 |access-date=2015-09-22}}{{cite web|url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/slideshows/slideshow-all-that-will-happen-on-kbc-this-holi/ |title=Ranbir Kapoor talks about the music of Rockstar | Latest bollywood Hindi Movie Features |website=[[Bollywood Hungama]] |date=2011-10-14 |access-date=2015-09-22}} *The 2014 film ''[[Main Aur Mr. Riight]]'' has a song named ''Desi Daru'' sung by [[Jasbir Jassi]].{{cite news |url=http://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/screen/main-aur-mr-riight-a-tad-too-cheesy/ |title=Main Aur Mr. Riight / A tad too cheesy! |newspaper=[[The Indian Express]] |date=2014-12-19 |access-date=2015-09-22}}{{cite web|url=http://indiablooms.com/ibns_new/showbiz-details/B/747/teaser-for-desi-daru-song-from-main-aur-mr-riight-is-out-now.html |title=Teaser for Desi Daru song from Main Aur Mr Riight is out now | Indiablooms -
